scan_linter_check.description:
Flags server-side GlideRecord, GlideRecordSecure and GlideAggregate updates that affect every record in the table: updateMultiple() on a GlideRecord with no conditions, and update() inside while (gr.next()) over a query with no conditions.
Detection: the check parses the script and follows GlideRecord variables within each function in source order. A condition is any addQuery, addEncodedQuery, addActiveQuery, addInactiveQuery, addNullQuery, addNotNullQuery or addJoinQuery call on the same variable before the update. setLimit() is not treated as a condition.
Not flagged here: updates whose conditions exist but cannot be verified (run-time values, invalid fields, conditions on some code paths only, GlideRecords passed in from elsewhere). Those are reported by SN-GR-003-R. current.update() is not in scope (see the Business Rule checks).
Client-only scripts (Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Scripts) are skipped.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-003: GlideRecord update with no query conditions
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Add query conditions that limit the update to the intended records and test them with a count (GlideAggregate) before updating. If updating every record is intended (for example a one-off data fix), mute the finding with a reason.
scan_linter_check.short_description: updateMultiple() or update() in a loop, with no query conditions.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-GR-003: GlideRecord update with no query conditions
